title: Whistleblower Protection Clause Detector for AI Company Policies

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible with gap: detecting clause presence is useful for accountability but does not ensure better protections in practice. Scales an existing manual assessment (FLI sub-indicator).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: rule-based NLP checking for specific ISO 37002 criteria in policy text is accessible. Well-defined matching rules against a known standard.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable: check specific policy clauses against specific ISO criteria. Clear input (company policies), clear checklist (ISO 37002), clear output (presence/strength scores).

novelty.reasoning: While AI whistleblower protection is a very active policy topic (AI Whistleblower Protection Act introduced May 2025, 'Right to Warn' letter June 2024, OpenAI NDA controversy), no existing work applies automated NLP-based detection of ISO 37002 compliance elements in AI company policies. The FLI AI Safety Index includes whistleblowing as one indicator but uses manual expert assessment, not automated detection. The specific combination of (1) rule-based NLP checking, (2) ISO 37002 criteria as the benchmark, and (3) applied to AI company policies specifically is novel. The policy context is well-documented but the technical tool does not exist.
